_comment: NOT Meridiano's inbox. GET /notifications/mine answered {"notifications":[]} for ana.rojas (org-meridiano.json, 11 Sep), luis.mora and diego.solano (read-only GETs, 11 Sep), and the screen draws that as an empty inbox (the primary shot). This file exists only to photograph the screen WITH rows, and every row is what a producer in the code writes, shaped as NotificationDetail: a survey invitation and a manual reminder for the running Q4, their titles and message the Spanish defaults of SurveyDistributionEndpoints.cs (DefaultSubject / DefaultReminderSubject / DefaultMessage, joined to the survey title by Compose), their data SurveyNotificationData's two keys. Ids, times and the recipient being Ana are invented. Both rows are unread because the harness ignores query strings, so the shell bell's ?unreadOnly=true poll gets every row: a read row here would make the bell and the page disagree on a fixture artefact. /profile and /notifications/preferences are the real payloads copied from org-meridiano.json.
